subject: Adjustment memo and VAT allocation for May ingestion spike
messages:
From: Alyssa King <alyssa.king@nebulahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@nebulahealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T09:12:00Z
Subject: May bill spike — request for adjustment & VAT breakdown

Hi Marcus,

We received the May invoice this morning and saw a large unexpected usage spike on 2026-05-01 (line items attached). Our engineering team discovered a duplicate ingestion job that reprocessed ~1.3M tokens for a single connector run — that caused the billing jump.

Can Redwood issue a provisional adjustment for the excess tokens and confirm how the VAT will be handled for the EU portion of our account? Specifically:
- A one-time adjustment to remove the duplicate ingestion charges (approx. $4,200 gross)
- Whether the VAT on that adjustment will be invoiced gross or treated under reverse-charge (we're EU-based, VAT ID: EU1234567)
- Estimated timeline for credit to appear on next statement

I've attached the invoice and the connector job IDs for your finance team. We'd like to pause collections on the disputed amount until this is resolved.

Attachments: [nebula_invoice_May2026.pdf (PDF, 540KB)]

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa King
Head of Cloud Integrations
Nebula Health
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa King <alyssa.king@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T14:30:00Z
Subject: Re: May bill spike — request for adjustment & VAT breakdown

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the quick heads up and for attaching the invoice. I'm sorry about the noisy spike; we want to make this easy to close out. Proposed next steps:

1) Provisional goodwill offset: we can apply a provisional offset for the duplicate-run portion while we validate the logs (target: $4,200 gross). This will appear as a service concession on your account and should be visible as a credit memo.
2) VAT handling: we need to confirm Nebula's VAT ID and whether you prefer a net credit (reverse charge applies) or a gross credit with VAT documentation. If reverse charge is applicable, we'll issue the adjustment net and include VAT evidence for your records.
3) Timeline: once you confirm VAT preference and provide the connector job IDs (and any PO reference), finance will process the adjustment within 5 business days. The accounting entry will be an adjustment memo and a credit memo referencing the original invoice number.

Please send:
- Confirmation of VAT treatment (reverse-charge vs gross)
- PO or billing reference to include on the credit memo
- Any additional evidence your team wants on the memo (e.g., URN or internal ticket ID)

Cc'ing Chloe to coordinate issuance of the adjustment memo and to drop the provisional credit into staging.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Account Exec, Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: adjustment_memo_TBD (will be sent after confirmation)]

Date: 2026-05-15T08:05:00Z
Subject: Re: May bill spike — request for adjustment & VAT breakdown

Marcus — quick follow-up. We're confirming the VAT ID (EU1234567 is valid) and Nebula prefers reverse-charge treatment for B2B adjustments. Tom from finance is copied for PO reference; PO #NH-2026-458 should be included on the credit memo.

Attached a CSV extract with the ingestion job IDs and timestamps you asked for. The duplicate job runs are 2026-05-01T02:14:10Z and 2026-05-01T02:15:01Z — same payload reprocessed twice. We agree provisional offset of $4,200 gross, but will accept a net adjustment if you apply reverse-charge VAT treatment documented in the memo.

Please also confirm collections hold on that invoice amount while this is in-flight; we don't want the ledger to be marked overdue.

Thanks,
Alyssa

Attachments: [vat_evidence_EU.csv (CSV, 12KB), connector_job_ids.txt (TXT, 2KB)]

Date: 2026-05-18T15:47:00Z
Subject: Final: Adjustment memo (provisional credit) and VAT split instructions

Hi Alyssa and Tom —

Thanks for the quick confirmation and for sending the CSV. We've completed our validation. Summary and resolution:

- Validation: engineering confirmed the duplicate ingestion runs you flagged (timestamps match). Charge attributable to duplicates: $4,200 gross.
- Provisional action: Redwood will issue a provisional service concession equal to the full gross amount ($4,200) on 2026-05-19. This will appear as a credit memo referencing invoice #INV-2026-05-017.
- VAT treatment: because Nebula provided a valid EU VAT ID and requested reverse-charge treatment, we'll issue the adjustment net of VAT and include a VAT statement for your records. Finance will annotate the credit memo with PO NH-2026-458 and the reverse-charge note.
- Collections: we've placed a temporary collections hold on the disputed line so it will not be sent to collections while the adjustment posts.
- Deliverables: you'll receive an adjustment memo (PDF) and the official credit memo by end-of-day 2026-05-19. The adjustment_memo_ML_20260518.pdf will include the job IDs and a short rationale for your audit trail.

Internal notes: looping Soojin to confirm the VAT evidence file goes into the EU tax pack and to assist with the accounting entry. Chloe — please push the provisional credit to staging and route the credit memo to billing@nebulahealth.com once generated.

If anything changes on your end (PO cancels or further evidence), flag us ASAP. Otherwise we'll close the ticket once the memo and credit are issued.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Exec, Strategic Customers
Redwood Inference
